              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.

              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.

              readOnly: true

              title: Check digit
              description: >-

              example: 'HH-3F2A9C1D5E6B7A8C'
              readOnly: true

              title: Namesake count
              description: >-

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1

              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true

              description: >-

              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true

              description: >-

              readOnly: true

              description: >-

              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-

                registration business day at the moment this owner was created; false

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true

              readOnly: true

              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.

## Overview

The single write endpoint is `POST /api/owners`, implemented as an OfficeFloor function pipeline defined in YAML, with each step a small Java "function" class. DTOs (`OwnerDto`, `OwnerFieldsDto`, `OwnerPageDto`) are generated at build time from `openapi.yml` by the openapi-generator Maven plugin (package `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto`, suffix `Dto`) — there is no hand-written `OwnerRequest`/`OwnerResponse`. The `Owner` JPA entity is the persisted model; `OwnerMapper` (MapStruct) maps between entity and DTO.

Important: the test `AcceptanceTest.coreFlagsPossibleDuplicate` expects a NOT-YET-IMPLEMENTED soft-match feature (`possibleDuplicate` / `possibleDuplicateOf`). I confirmed neither identifier exists anywhere under `src/main`. Implementing that feature is the apparent goal.

---

## 1. OfficeFloor REST YAML for POST owners

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml` — the create pipeline. Steps run in order, each `next:` chaining to the following, all under `transaction` governance, authorized by `hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')`:

`validate` (ValidateOwnerFields) -> `checkCityCapacity` (CheckOwnerCityCapacity) -> `checkDailyLimit` (CheckOwnerDailyLimit) -> `build` (BuildOwner) -> `assignHousehold` (AssignHousehold) -> `checkIdentity` (CheckOwnerIdentityUnique) -> `assignHouseholdSize` (AssignHouseholdSize) -> `assignCustomerCode` (AssignCustomerCode) -> `assignNamesakeCount` (AssignNamesakeCount) -> `assignBulkSignupWarning` (AssignBulkSignupWarning) -> `save` (SaveOwner) -> `audit` (AuditOwnerCreated) -> `respond` (RespondWithOwnerCreated).

(Full contents shown earlier; the file's own comment documents that `checkIdentity` is the single hard-duplicate step and runs before `save` so a duplicate is a 409, not a persisted record.)

Related read path used by the test to verify fields:
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners/{ownerId}.GET.yml` — `load` (LoadOwner) -> `respond` (RespondWithOwner).
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.GET.yml` — `ListOwners`.

To add a soft-match step you would insert a new function into `owners.POST.yml`'s chain (e.g. between `assignBulkSignupWarning` and `save`, so the flags are computed against pre-existing owners and persisted).

---

## 2. Java function classes referenced by the POST YAML

All under `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`. Signatures/roles (full contents shown above where load-bearing):

- `ValidateOwnerFields.java` — `service(@RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto request, Out<OwnerFieldsDto> validated)`. Reads body once, validates required fields, normalizes address/telephone/email, validates postcode + registrationDate, republishes via `Out`. Throws `OwnerFieldsInvalidException` (400).
- `CheckOwnerCityCapacity.java` — `service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto request, OwnerRepository)`. Rejects when city has >=50 owners (409). Normalizes city case/whitespace.
- `CheckOwnerDailyLimit.java` — `service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto request, OwnerRepository)`. Rejects at >=100 owners for the business-day-adjusted registration date (429).
- `BuildOwner.java` — `service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto request, OwnerMapper, Out<Owner> built)`. Maps DTO->entity, defaults + business-day-adjusts registrationDate.
- `AssignHousehold.java` — `service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto request, @Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository)`. Only when `sharesHousehold==true`; assigns/back-fills shared `householdId` keyed on normalized lastName+address (SHA-256 derived `HH-…`).
- `CheckOwnerIdentityUnique.java` — `service(@Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository)`. The single hard-duplicate check: throws `OwnerIdentityConflictException` (409) when the whole `IdentityKey.of(owner)` matches an existing owner.
- `AssignHouseholdSize.java` — sets `householdSize` (count sharing `householdId`, incl. new).
- `AssignCustomerCode.java` — sets `customerCode` = `<REGION>-<HASH8>` (region from postcode via `Locality.regionOf`; HASH8 = first 8 upper-hex of SHA-256 of telephone+lastName).
- `AssignNamesakeCount.java` — sets `namesakeCount` (existing owners with same first+last, case-insensitive).
